/docs/showcase/ai/agentic-workflows/boun.title: Encapsulated agent task
/docs/showcase/ai/agentic-workflows/boun.localProfile: Run a bounded finite-state agent over an allowlist of local numeric tools, verify the measured answer against the source observations, and independently publish the answer and complete tool trace. The smoke profile uses deterministic tool selection, not an external LLM.

/docs/showcase/ai/agentic-workflows/mult.title: Multi-agent review
/docs/showcase/ai/agentic-workflows/mult.localProfile: Run three independent local reviewer programs in parallel: statistical review, independent numeric recomputation, and domain-bound checks. A critic checks agreement and accepts or corrects a supplied mean before the synthesis is published. The reviewers are deterministic programs rather than hosted LLM agents.

/docs/showcase/ai/agentic-workflows/supe.title: Supervised tool loop
/docs/showcase/ai/agentic-workflows/supe.localProfile: Propose a sandboxed summary-writing action, enforce an allowlist, replay a clearly identified approval fixture, execute the local tool, and verify its output and digest. Set AKOFLOW_APPROVAL_FILE to supply an explicit approval record; the bundled approval is only for this smoke example.

/docs/showcase/ai/generative-ai/ai-video.title: AI Video Studio
/docs/showcase/ai/generative-ai/ai-video.localProfile: Create a storyboard, procedural scene frames, generated narration audio, and a video from a versioned local brief. FFmpeg is used when available on the host; the supplied Docker image includes it. The portable fallback writes a valid YUV4MPEG stream rather than pretending to have produced an MP4.

/docs/showcase/ai/generative-ai/audio-tr.title: Audio transcription and summarization
/docs/showcase/ai/generative-ai/audio-tr.localProfile: Create a real PCM WAV from a bundled synthetic tone vocabulary, split it into two audio segments, decode tone frequencies independently, merge the decoded words, and produce a frequency-based summary. This tiny offline recognizer is an audio-processing teaching profile; it does not perform natural-speech recognition.

/docs/showcase/ai/generative-ai/document.title: OCR and document extraction
/docs/showcase/ai/generative-ai/document.localProfile: Rasterize bundled invoice digits to a PBM scan, recognize those pixels with a digit-template OCR algorithm, read native text in a parallel branch, classify the invoice, extract fields, and validate the result against its source. This portable OCR profile covers the bundled digit alphabet.

/docs/showcase/ai/generative-ai/local-ra.title: Local RAG Factory
/docs/showcase/ai/generative-ai/local-ra.localProfile: Build a local lexical retrieval index over the bundled text corpus, answer questions by retrieving source evidence, and check the answers against versioned known-answer tests. No hosted embedding or LLM service is required.

/docs/showcase/ai/generative-ai/rag-inde.title: RAG index construction and evaluation
/docs/showcase/ai/generative-ai/rag-inde.localProfile: Clean and chunk a bundled document corpus, compute normalized TF-IDF vectors, build a portable JSON search index, and run retrieval and extractive-answer checks in parallel. This CPU profile uses lexical embeddings and source quotations, not a hosted embedding model or a generative LLM.

/docs/showcase/ai/generative-ai/syntheti.title: Synthetic dataset generation
/docs/showcase/ai/generative-ai/syntheti.localProfile: Generate structured question/answer examples from versioned topic templates in three parallel batches, reject invalid rows, remove overlapping questions, verify topic coverage, and publish JSON Lines plus a quality report. The portable generator is template-based and requires no LLM.

/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/anoma.title: Anomaly detection
/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/anoma.localProfile: Fit a Gaussian sensor baseline, score held-out normal and anomalous signals, select a threshold by measured F1, and publish the detected anomalies and calibration metrics.

/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/batch.title: Batch inference
/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/batch.localProfile: Train/load a small numeric model, split versioned input values into three disjoint shards, execute real inference in parallel, validate that the merged indices have no gaps or duplicates, and publish predictions as JSON Lines.

/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/compu.title: Computer vision training
/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/compu.localProfile: Generate seeded noisy 8×8 geometric-pattern images from the bundled input specification, validate labels, augment only training images, learn class centroids, and evaluate classification on held-out images. This small offline dataset is not CIFAR-10.

/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/hyper.title: Hyperparameter search
/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/hyper.localProfile: Train three independent gradient-descent regressors with different learning rates and epoch budgets, rank their measured held-out errors, and publish the best learned model and leaderboard.

/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/infer.title: Inference benchmark
/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/infer.localProfile: Measure actual local CPU inference with three batching profiles and verify identical predictions. The branches named CPU, GPU, and edge use CPU fallback batching in the portable profile; no GPU/edge hardware performance or cloud billing is claimed.

/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/infra.title: Infrastructure selection for training
/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/infra.localProfile: Measure a local CPU model fit, compare three infrastructure plans using explicitly declared speed/startup/price assumptions, select a plan, and train the final model locally. This smoke example provisions no infrastructure and reports estimates separately from measured error.

/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/lora-.title: LoRA fine-tuning
/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/lora-.localProfile: Freeze a bundled 2×2 base matrix and learn a rank-one additive adapter with gradient descent. Validate loss reduction, publish the adapter weights, and record dataset/base lineage in a parallel branch. This CPU teaching model does not download or fine-tune an LLM.

/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/model.title: Comparative model evaluation
/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/model.localProfile: Evaluate an ordinary-least-squares model, a mean baseline, and a limited-budget gradient-descent model on the same held-out rows, rank their errors, and approve only a candidate that passes the declared accuracy threshold.

/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/model.title: Model conversion and quantization
/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/model.localProfile: Export a learned affine model as real ONNX and TorchScript files, generate int8 and IEEE float16 coefficient representations in parallel, reload both executable formats, and compare their numeric outputs against the original model. The float16 branch runs on CPU and does not build or claim a TensorRT engine.

/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/model.title: Model distillation
/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/model.localProfile: Generate soft labels with a local sigmoid teacher, fit a cheaper affine student, evaluate it against held-out teacher predictions, and measure actual CPU prediction latency in a parallel branch.

/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/model.title: Model ensemble
/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/model.localProfile: Train three regressors on different data subsets in independent activities, combine their held-out predictions with a mean ensemble, validate RMSE, and publish the learned ensemble.

/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/train.title: Training with MLflow
/docs/showcase/ai/machine-learning/train.localProfile: Fit a linear regression on bundled measurements, evaluate held-out rows, publish a content-addressed local model registry entry, and independently log parameters, metrics, and the model artifact through the real MLflow SDK to a local SQLite tracking store. No hosted MLflow server is needed.

/docs/showcase/ai/scientific-ai/ai-assis.title: Scientific pipeline with AI interpretation
/docs/showcase/ai/scientific-ai/ai-assis.localProfile: Integrate a first-order decay equation, compare numerical measurements with the analytic solution, independently infer the decay rate using log-linear regression, and validate both branches before publishing a report. The smoke profile uses a small numerical experiment and a fitted regression model; it does not call a hosted LLM.

/docs/showcase/ai/scientific-ai/experime.title: Model-guided experiment cycle
/docs/showcase/ai/scientific-ai/experime.localProfile: Fit a quadratic response model from local observations, propose a new experiment batch, enforce parameter limits, execute the proposed experiments, and verify that the measured optimum improves on the original observations. This is a numerical closed loop, not a hardware experiment.

/docs/showcase/ai/scientific-ai/surrogat.title: Surrogate model construction
/docs/showcase/ai/scientific-ai/surrogat.localProfile: Evaluate a damped-response integral in two independent simulation shards, assemble the samples, fit a piecewise-linear surrogate, and validate it against held-out numerical evaluations. All computation runs locally on the CPU.

/docs/showcase/document-ai/document-inte.title: Document Intelligence
/docs/showcase/document-ai/document-inte.localProfile: Read the bundled business documents, classify them, extract structured fields, reconcile invoice lines, and publish a checked report. Every stage performs local data processing and passes its files to the next activity.

/docs/showcase/media/video-intelligence.title: Video Intelligence
/docs/showcase/media/video-intelligence.localProfile: Generate a three-scene video, independently inspect container metadata, scene boundaries, and audio, merge the measurements into a timeline, and publish a validated report. The supplied Docker image uses FFmpeg for the actual video analysis.

/docs/showcase/rendering/blender-render-.title: Blender Render Farm
/docs/showcase/rendering/blender-render-.localProfile: Build a real Blender scene, render even and odd frames in parallel using Cycles on the CPU, compose an MP4, and verify all six frames. The default command uses Docker, so the host does not need a Blender installation. No JSON file is represented as a .blend file.

/docs/showcase/scientific-workflows/mont.title: Montage 050 locally
/docs/showcase/scientific-workflows/mont.localProfile: Run all 58 original Montage 050d activities locally, using the immutable amd64 image and its twelve bundled FITS observations. The default uses two CPU slots, preserves the 138 named file handoffs, creates three calibrated astronomical mosaics and a color preview, and provisions no cloud machines. This is a long-running scientific workload; on Apple Silicon Docker uses amd64 emulation.
